payload.body_they: {{Name}} learns a lot about themselves by noticing what they are willing to pursue, defend, change, and say no to. Action gives them information about what matters. They may not know how strongly they care until they find themselves fighting for something or refusing to let someone else decide for them. The important distinction is between protecting something that still matters and continuing a struggle simply because they have already put so much effort into it.
